info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Product Service Agency API
info.description: This API allows users to update existing product service agency details within the banking microservices ecosystem. It targets specific agencies identified by unique parameters, providing flexibility for modifications such as contact information, service offerings, and other relevant attributes. Typical consumers include banking administrators and third-party service connectors who manage product service agency relationships. Enhance the accuracy and relevance of service agencies in your application through seamless updates.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific Product Service Agency identified by its unique ID. Ensure all required fields are included in the request to process the update successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the product specified by the product ID. The body must conform to the defined JSON schema and provide the necessary fields required for the update operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
